description: Price a competitive EIP-1559 bid for a contested transaction using eth_feeHistory reward percentiles (p50 normal / p75 fast / p90 war). maxFeePerGas is a refundable ceiling; the tip is the real spend. Reports viable:false when a cap would put the bid below the observed market rather than silently clamping to a losing number.
name: nft_mint_gas_price
